# DMDS — Tampa Bay Digital Studio

> DMDS (DM Digital Solutions) is a one-engineer digital studio in Palm Harbor, FL building websites, apps, AI automation and digital marketing systems for Tampa Bay businesses — engineered with flight-software discipline. Every quantitative claim on the studio page lives in a versioned claims registry and every release is test-attested (the certificate binds the exact served bytes).

Contact: dennis@dmds.studio

## Pages

- [Studio](https://dmds.studio/): identity, capabilities (web design, web development, app development, AI automation, digital marketing), proof-of-work dossiers (Zoo Code AI platform, Insure With Mink growth engine, Comfort Airz field-service platform), claims registry and release-attestation trail
- [Contractor Web Design — Tampa Bay](https://dmds.studio/contractor-web-design-tampa/): web design for contractors and trade businesses (marine, tree, HVAC) across Tampa Bay — diagnosis-first structure, published pricing (builds $3,500–$8,500; BASE $95/month, GROWTH $495/month), objection FAQ, and an honest "who this is not for" section

## Facts

- Based in Palm Harbor, FL; serving Tampa Bay (Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater and surrounding communities)
- Pages are single self-contained HTML documents: zero external requests on load, no third-party analytics or trackers
- Founder/operator: Dennis Mink (https://github.com/0xMink)
- Source and release attestation: https://github.com/0xMink/dmds
